integrity: The lower bound is forced pairwise by vertex-versus-clique-edge comparisons. At equality, the proof classifies matching transversals and uses exact zero-distance and two-distance coordinate sets to prove sufficiency and count every basis. A standalone checker independently computes mixed distance vectors.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to complete prisms K_n square K_2 with n at least five.
The n=4 boundary case has a different minimum size and is excluded.
No claim is made for K_m square K_n when both factors have order at least three.
Finite exhaustive verification over 5 <= n <= 9 is corroborative only; the all-n theorem follows from the signature proof.
Search coverage cannot exclude a differently named or non-indexed complete-prism treatment.
title: Mixed metric bases of complete prisms
